cal.title: Do the probabilities tell the truth?
cal.sub: A pick logged at 60% should win about 6 times in 10. Only wins and losses count.
cal.brierNote: Brier: the squared error between the probability and what happened (0 is perfect, 0.25 is a coin flip). Lower is better. The market is the margin-free probability of the two-sided close, compared on the same picks.

chartSummary.one: {label}: probability said against what happened, {n} pick in {buckets} buckets. Above the diagonal, they won more than said.
chartSummary.other: {label}: probability said against what happened, {n} picks in {buckets} buckets. Above the diagonal, they won more than said.

cal.howToRead: Each dot is a probability bucket: what was said to the right, what happened upwards. Well calibrated hugs the diagonal; dot size is its n.
cal.noBuckets: No won or lost picks with this probability under these filters.

cl.title: Price against the close
cl.sub: EV vs close: the price taken against the margin-free closing probability. It is the measure that does not depend on the luck of the result.

histSummary.one: Distribution of EV vs close: {n} pick, mean {mean}.
histSummary.other: Distribution of EV vs close: {n} picks, mean {mean}. Right of the line, picks that beat the margin-free close.

clvSummary.one: Distribution of raw CLV: {n} pick, mean {mean}.
clvSummary.other: Distribution of raw CLV: {n} picks, mean {mean}.

cl.sourceTitle: By where the close comes from
cl.sourceSub: As the reviews do: the same book's close when there is one, otherwise the bet365 feed's.
cl.movesTitle: How the close moved by market
cl.movesSub: Price taken against the close at the same source (raw CLV), graded picks only.
cl.movesNote: “Shortened” means the market moved towards the pick (it closed lower than the price taken). Raw CLV still carries the book's margin: EV vs close is the measure that counts.
cl.pinTitle: Pinnacle: towards the pick or against it?
cl.pinSub: Result picks with a Pinnacle id: Pinnacle's margin-free 1X2 from the opening to the last read.
cl.pinNote: A change of less than half a probability point counts as “no move”. It is a note only: it changes no verdict.
